traits.name: Steady Balance
traits.text: When the acrobat rolls a success on an Acrobatics check, they get a critical success instead. They aren't flat-footed when attempting to Balance and can attempt an Acrobatics check instead of a Reflex save to Grab an Edge.

traits.name: Cat Fall
traits.text: The acrobat treats all falls as 50 feet shorter.

traits.name: Nimble Dodge
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The acrobat is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see Effect The acrobat gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The acrobat deals an extra 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

traits.name: Swinging Strike
traits.text: ⬺ The acrobat swings on a rope or trapeze, moving up to double their Speed. At any point during the swing, they can make a melee Strike.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +10 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d4+4 (1d4+4) piercing
